SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.HORIZONTALCODE, B.SAMPLENUM, B.SENDDATE, B.SAMPLINGDEPTH, C.INDEXNAME, D.ANALYSISUSERNAME, D.EQUIPTID AS ANALYSISEQUIPTID, D.ASSISTEQUIPTID AS ANALYSISASSISTEQUIPTID, E.EQUIPTID AS ANALYSISEQUIPTNO, E.SPECIFICATION AS ANALYSISSPECIFICATION, E.EQUIPTNAME AS ANALYSISEQUIPTNAME, (SELECT max(MAINTENDDATE) FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_RECORD ER WHERE ER.EQUIPTID = D.EQUIPTID AND ER.COMPLETEFLAG = '2') AS ANALYSISEQUIPTRECORDDATE, F.ANALYSISORGID, F.ANALYSISORGNAME, H.SAMPLEUSERNAME, H.MONITORPOINTCATEGORYID, H.MONITORPOINTCATEGORY, H.MONITORPOINTNAME AS FOLDERMONITORPOINTNAME, H.PROCESSSTATUS, H.LONGITUDE, H.LATITUDE, H.PLANSAMPLEDATE, F.EQUIPTID AS SAMPLEEQUIPTID, F.ASSISTEQUIPTID AS SAMPLEASSISTEEQUIPTID, F.assistEquiptName AS SAMPLEASSISTEQUIPTNAME, G.EQUIPTID AS SAMPLEEQUIPTNO, G.SPECIFICATION AS SAMPLEESPECIFICATION, G.EQUIPTNAME AS SAMPLEEQUIPTNAME, (SELECT max(MAINTENDDATE) FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_RECORD ER WHERE ER.EQUIPTID = F.EQUIPTID AND ER.COMPLETEFLAG = '2') AS SAMPLEEQUIPTRECORDDATE, I.REGISTDATE, I.PROJNO, M.TESTMETHODBASIS, N.COEFFICIENT, N.LIMITUNITNAME, N.DETECTEDQUANTITY, N.DETECTEDQUANTITYUNIT, N.ALLOWABLEERROR, TM.MULTIPLEITEMGROUP, Q.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, CASE WHEN NVL(H.MONITORPOINTNO, ' ') = NVL(H.MONITORPOINTNAME, ' ') THEN H.MONITORPOINTNAME ELSE H.MONITORPOINTNO || H.MONITORPOINTNAME END AS REPORTMONITORPOINTNAME FROM T_EMC_REPORT_RESULT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER B ON A.ORDERID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX C ON A.INDEXID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_RUN D ON D.ID = A.RUNID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT E ON E.ID = D.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK F ON F.ID = A.ORDERTASKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT G ON G.ID = F.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_FOLDER H ON H.ID = A.FOLDERID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT I ON I.ID = A.PROJID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD M ON M.ID = A.METHODID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD TM ON TM.ID = A.TESTMETHODID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM N ON A.ITEMID = N.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_CONTAINER Q ON A.ORDERID = Q.ORDERID AND F.ORDERCONTAINERID = Q.ID ) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
